description.value:
You detonate a massive blast centered on a point within range. Every creature within a 40-foot-radius sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 40d6 fire damage and be knocked prone; a successful save halves the damage and keeps the creature standing.

The fire curls around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects in the area.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 9
